Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.

Resolve the Return the Favor copy, creating a copy of Return the Favor, targeting the original Return the Favor.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Return the Favor copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

 Repeat each turn.
